measurementNotes: Request work sums overlapping model service durations; it is not wall time saved.
Peak request concurrency is derived from client request start/end intervals; it is not provider GPU utilization.
Harness context estimates are heuristic, actual provider token usage is separate.
Retained logical bytes are measured after cleanup; they are neither peak disk use nor allocated physical blocks.
CPU, memory, peak disk and queue wait were not measured and remain unknown.
Successful and failed wall times are separate; unknown metrics never become zero.
Fixed-peak-tariff cost is an exploratory post-run normalization, not a billed amount or a replacement for the frozen actual-cost accounting.
Completion with done workers can legitimately have zero worker Forks.
